summary: Exited at t=9m after the position round-tripped from a +22-30pt peak down to -7.75 (net loss), a 38% giveback of the leg's realized amplitude. The trigger was confluence: HA-against and PROPP-against both fired in the same frame, coinciding with the price crossing back through breakeven into a loss. Next time I'd watch for this same pattern earlier - a single against-fire near the peak (frame 6-8, KMDR/PROPP-against) was an early warning that giveback was accelerating; a tighter partial-exit or trail once giveback crossed ~15-20% of amp, rather than waiting for full breakeven-cross, would have preserved more of the peak profit.
